description: Issue #867 (PR #884 cross-vendor review fix): neutralizes RequestBindingPolicy.Classify's gateway-TYPE guard (`if (IsBannedGatewayType(memberType)) return BindingRejectionReason.GatewayType;`, src/WalkingTec.Mvvm.Core/Helper/RequestBindingPolicy.cs) with a compile-preserving `&& false` (not a deletion). Issue #1080 moved this guard's walk out of IsPathAllowed and into Classify (which returns a BindingRejectionReason instead of bool); IsPathAllowed(object, string, string) -- what RedoUpdateModel actually calls -- is now a pure delegation (`Classify(...) == BindingRejectionReason.None`), so this mutant still turns the HTTP-level assertions below red exactly as before the refactor. This is the rewritten guard that replaced the original declaring-type/name check the review found bypassable via alias properties, new-shadowing, intermediate base classes, interface-typed members, and closed generic type parameters -- see wtmsec867-gateway-type-guard-neutralize-shapes for the mutant covering those five shapes directly. This entry covers the original, simpler end-to-end HTTP exploit the guard also still has to stop: RequestBindingScopeHttpTests867.GetPagingData_HostileConfigInfoIsQuickDebugField_DoesNotFlipConfig_LegitimateSearcherBindingStillWorks (direct key 'ConfigInfo.IsQuickDebug') and GetPagingData_HostileAliasedConfigInfoFields_DoNotFlipConfig (the issue's own alias example, 'Searcher.Wtm.ConfigInfo.IsQuickDebug', plus the depth-cap-isolating 'Wtm.ConfigInfo.IsQuickDebug'). Both assert on WTMContext's actual process-wide IOptionsMonitor<Configs>.CurrentValue.IsQuickDebug value (resolved from the factory's own DI container), not a response status code -- with the guard neutralized, the POST still returns 200 and IsQuickDebug is observably flipped to true. The green control, GetPagingData_HostileSearcherModeBatchField_DoesNotBypassRowFiltering, posts only 'Searcher.ZipCode'/'SearcherMode'/'Ids' -- none of which resolve to a banned gateway type -- so it is genuinely unaffected by this mutant.
target_symbol: RequestBindingPolicy.Classify(Type, string, string) -- the `if (IsBannedGatewayType(memberType)) return BindingRejectionReason.GatewayType;` guard condition (reached via IsPathAllowed(object, string, string)'s Issue #1080 delegation, which is what RedoUpdateModel actually calls)

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Api.Test.RequestBindingS: a caller-supplied 'ConfigInfo\.IsQuickDebug' form field must never reach the process-wide Configs singleton
neither the 'Wtm\.ConfigInfo\.IsQuickDebug' nor the aliased 'Searcher\.Wtm\.ConfigInfo\.IsQuickDebug' form field may reach the process-wide Configs singleton

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Re-captured verbatim (issue #1080 refactor: patch retargeted from IsPathAllowed to Classify) against a clean checkout with the regenerated mutant patch applied (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first): GetPagingData_HostileConfigInfoIsQuickDebugField_DoesNotFlipConfig_LegitimateSearcherBindingStillWorks -> 'Assert.IsFalse failed. #867: a caller-supplied '\''ConfigInfo.IsQuickDebug'\'' form field must never reach the process-wide Configs singleton through RedoUpdateModel's raw reflection write.'; GetPagingData_HostileAliasedConfigInfoFields_DoNotFlipConfig -> 'Assert.IsFalse failed. #867: neither the '\''Wtm.ConfigInfo.IsQuickDebug'\'' nor the aliased '\''Searcher.Wtm.ConfigInfo.IsQuickDebug'\'' form field may reach the process-wide Configs singleton — the declaring-type check must catch '\''Wtm'\'' wherever in the dotted path it appears, not just as the key's literal first segment.'. Confirmed via python3 test/mutants/run_mutant.py --mutant wtmsec867-gateway-type-guard-neutralize: 'VERDICT: KILLED' / 'GATE: PASS'.
